intent: Bin a numeric feature into coarse buckets and compare average outcomes across those bins.
sql_skeleton:
SELECT CASE
           WHEN {band_col} < {band_cut_1} THEN 'low'
           WHEN {band_col} < {band_cut_2} THEN 'mid'
           ELSE 'high'
       END AS band_bucket,
       AVG({measure_col}) AS avg_measure
FROM {table}
GROUP BY band_bucket
ORDER BY avg_measure DESC;
notes: Important for numeric-heavy datasets where raw continuous features must be discretized before subgroup reasoning.

intent: Score a numeric measure globally and surface high-z-score outliers.
sql_skeleton:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT CAST({measure_col} AS FLOAT) AS measure_value
    FROM {table}
    WHERE {measure_col} IS NOT NULL
), stats AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(measure_value) AS mean_value,
        STDDEV(measure_value) AS stddev_value
    FROM base
), scored AS (
    SELECT
        measure_value,
        (measure_value - mean_value) / NULLIF(stddev_value, 0) AS z_score
    FROM base CROSS JOIN stats
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(z_score) > {z_threshold} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outlier_count,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ABS(z_score) > {z_threshold} THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS outlier_rate,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ABS(z_score) > {z_threshold} THEN ABS(z_score) ELSE NULL END) AS mean_abs_z,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ABS(z_score) > {z_threshold} THEN ABS(z_score) ELSE NULL END) AS max_abs_z,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ABS(z_score) > {z_threshold} AND z_score > 0 THEN 1.0 WHEN ABS(z_score) > {z_threshold} THEN 0.0 ELSE NULL END) AS positive_tail_share,
    MIN(CASE WHEN ABS(z_score) > {z_threshold} THEN measure_value ELSE NULL END) AS min_outlier_measure,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ABS(z_score) > {z_threshold} THEN measure_value ELSE NULL END) AS max_outlier_measure
FROM scored;
notes: Useful for tail-sensitive analytics and anomaly-style reporting.

intent: Select the highest quantile bucket of a numeric measure using NTILE-style ranking.
sql_skeleton:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT CAST({measure_col} AS FLOAT) AS measure_value
    FROM {table}
    WHERE {measure_col} IS NOT NULL
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        measure_value,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY measure_value DESC) AS rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_rows
    FROM base
), tail AS (
    SELECT measure_value, total_rows
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn <= ((total_rows + {num_tiles} - 1) / {num_tiles})
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS tail_count,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / NULLIF(MAX(total_rows), 0) AS tail_rate,
    AVG(measure_value) AS mean_tail_measure,
    MIN(measure_value) AS min_tail_measure,
    MAX(measure_value) AS max_tail_measure
FROM tail;
notes: A high-value tail template because it expresses rarity through quantile structure rather than an arbitrary threshold.
